subject: Post-POC microcase: concise impact recap + quick reference call
participants_external: sarah.liu@brightcart.com (Sarah Liu, Head of Product, BrightCart)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-POC microcase: concise impact recap + quick reference call

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for running the POC with us last week. We pulled together a short one-page summary (attached) but wanted to give you the headline metrics and a small ask: would BrightCart be open to a 10-minute "microcase" call so we can capture a one-line quote and confirm attribution? We want to keep it extremely lightweight.

Headlines from the 2-week POC (BrightCart, CartRelevance model):
- Avg inference latency reduced from 420ms -> 305ms (28% lower per-request latency)
- End-to-end throughput improvement: 3.4x at 99th percentile under your batch mix
- Token-unit cost reduction: ~42% cost per 1k tokens using our batching + KV-cache config
- Business signal: Cart conversion experiments showed a +1.6% lift in add-to-cart on sampled sessions (early, not A/B powered)

Attachment: redwood-poc-summary.pdf (one page, metrics and graphs).

What we’re asking:
1) Permission to use the metrics above and BrightCart name in a very short microcase (one-paragraph on a web page).
2) A one-line quote we can publish (e.g., “Redwood cut inference latency and helped us scale predictions with predictable cost”), OR a 10-minute call where we’ll capture that quote on the spot.

If a call works, here are two 10-min windows I can offer tomorrow (Pacific):
- Wed 4/21 09:00–09:10 PT
- Wed 4/21 11:30–11:40 PT

If neither works, a reply with a one-sentence quote is perfect.

Thanks, and appreciate the partnership — excited by the results.

—
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0167
redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-poc-summary.pdf (application/pdf, 1 page)

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightcart.com>

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the clear summary and for keeping this small. BrightCart is happy with the POC results and you have permission to use the metrics and our company name.

One-line quote we’re comfortable with: "Redwood helped BrightCart reduce inference latency and scale predictions more cost-effectively during our pilot."

I can do the 11:30–11:40 PT slot tomorrow to record a quick version of that if you’d like to capture tone. I’ll also share a logo file after the call.

—
Sarah Liu
Head of Product, BrightCart
sarah.liu@brightcart.com
